cues: In homogeneous catalysis, catalyst and reactants are in the same phase.
In the lead chamber process, nitric oxide gas takes up oxygen to become nitrogen dioxide, which hands the oxygen to sulphur dioxide and turns back into nitric oxide.
It goes round and round, and never appears in the overall equation.
Acid catalysed ester and sugar hydrolysis are homogeneous too.
